title: Merge Conversation Edits Across Devices (LWW + Lamport)
signature: class Replica: __init__(self, device), clock, put(msg_id, text), delete(msg_id), merge(state), state(), view()
hints: A stamp is (lamport, device). Compare stamps as tuples: the higher lamport wins, and on equal lamport the larger device id wins.
Delete must leave a tombstone. If you drop the entry, the next merge from a device that still has it brings the message back.
On merge, raise your clock to the largest lamport you received. Otherwise your next edit can carry a smaller stamp than an edit you have already seen, and it loses.
Merge per message: keep the entry with the larger ts, and keep the smaller created stamp.
